senses: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.22.12; also called in KJV: Asahiah;
a prince of the tribe of Simeon in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
a servant of king Josiah of Judah
a Merarite Levite, chief of his family, in the time of David

strongs.def: Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites
strongs.from: from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has made
